name: incremental method
definition_zh: 将荷载、位移或状态变化分解为增量逐步求解的方法。
usage_overview: 在轨道非线性及接触问题中，通过分步加载、累积位移并逐步更新刚度或界面耦合关系，求取加载过程中的结构响应。涉及接触闭合时，可按接触发生次序推进计算，使相互作用关系随接触状态调整。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, the direct iterative method and incremental method are used to calculate the static deformation of the track system.

Numerical Study In the numerical validation, the iterative method is adopted in the calculation of initial static deformation because of its high efficiency compared with the incremental method (as illustrated in Sec. 4), and the influence of nonlinearity of the ballasted bed lateral resistance and the curved rail beam on the vehicle–curved track model will also be discussed.
